baseline.scope: Synthetic development probe; current warm OS caches, no native agents or held-out tasks. Instrumented timers are inclusive and must not be added. Imports use fresh processes but uncontrolled OS caches.

candidate.scope: Synthetic development probe; current warm OS caches, no native agents or held-out tasks. Instrumented timers are inclusive and must not be added. Imports use fresh processes but uncontrolled OS caches.

unmatched_development_probe.interpretation: Unmatched development probes with uncontrolled timing/cache/host variation; not a causal before/after result and not pooled with the balanced experiment.

noignore_negative_control.interpretation: 23.10 to 10.71 ms on the unchanged-work control demonstrates confounding; do not attribute that apparent gain to policy caching.

historical_baseline_evidence_not_pooled.scope: Read-only historical evidence/configuration audit; no new benchmark, source policy, test run, task authoring or model request.

source_only_preparer.finding: The complete-source production preparer was already present and byte-identical when initially audited; automatic ranking/memory are separate optional paths. A whole-repository rollback is unnecessary and would discard intervening security/resource fixes.

matched_subset.selection: post-hoc first eight complete three-arm sequences after user stop
matched_subset.interpretation: Descriptive partial matched subset, not complete counterbalanced preregistered study or proof of savings.

warm_partial_study.active_source_B_path: Service(database, watch=False); initial approval/index, then matched per-stage reindex of the persistent approved root within each three-task sequence; prepare_prompt(...focus_paths, compact-prefix,12000); native process. No B Memglide memory session/capture, automatic ranking, MCP server or launcher subprocess.
warm_partial_study.shared_workflow: All arms receive known focus/support path hints and test argv, preserve protected tests, and pay the same structured summary+exact-findings output requirement. Canonical previous-stage reference fixes are identical for every arm; earlier model patches do not carry.
warm_partial_study.timing_scope: Includes Service/setup/index refresh, source preparation/current-source validation and independent source reconstruction audit plus native execution. Shared imports/harness startup, canonical reset and grading excluded. This is not standalone CLI startup or pure product latency.

source_support_confirmation.active_source_B_path: Fresh cold approval/index per focused assignment; native CLI through memglide.integrations.codex_preload with compact-prefix, --focus known paths, 12000 bytes. Supplied-context controls bypass state and retain original task unchanged. No support paths in B, no memory/automatic discovery/MCP.
source_support_confirmation.shared_workflow: Same original task, focus/support paths, test argv, model/settings and structured summary schema across all arms. Existing tests byte-identical; new tests in new files only.
source_support_confirmation.timing_scope: Cold approval/index plus actual preload launcher/native wall; excludes worktree creation/external grading; shared imports separate.
source_support_confirmation.prior_failed_study: All 60 earlier original assignments remain strict protected-test failures and are not regraded or pooled into this efficacy estimate. Campaign spend retains them separately.
source_support_confirmation.interpretation: Two-repeat controlled synthetic focused tasks show favorable cost point estimate but slower mean/median time. Supporting-test C costlier/slower than source-only B; support optional.

economic_limits: Actual invoices, subscription charges, discounts and exact provider request counts are unavailable. Prices are frozen historical API-list-price equivalents, not billed savings.
Cached input is included in total input. Input minus cache reads includes uncertain write attribution; native reported zero cache writes can be a decoder default.
Sensitivity ranges can reverse the cost ranking and are scenarios, not confidence intervals.

No causal attribution from read-command proxies: confirmation B recognized slightly more reads than A despite lower estimated cost; warm B recognized fewer. Underlying model calls and actual filesystem reads are unknown.
The same preloader code appears in both cohorts. Different task/workflow/cache conditions explain why these percentages cannot be treated as architecture-iteration effects.
Caller-known paths are an oracle boundary; source discovery effort is not measured. Neither positive cohort validates automatic task-to-file selection.
preserve_architecture: Existing approved root plus indexed eligibility; bounded read-only metadata checks.
Explicit caller-known focus paths; complete current UTF-8 files; canonical deterministic ordering and overlap deduplication.
Minimal compact-prefix JSON before the exact original task; hashes/ranges remain private diagnostics.
Current approval/ignore/sensitive-path/symlink/size checks and final source/policy revalidation; exact original-prompt fallback.
No auxiliary model, automatic graph/source discovery, background watcher or mandatory memory/MCP round trip in the context-preparation hot path.
Explicit context-supplied/off bypass before database/source state access.
do_not_restore: Do not hard-reset the whole repository to 58ba054 or 85ebff2; preserve subsequent security/resource corrections.
Do not automatically inject memory or supporting tests, launch automatic ranking/parser workers, or add MCP schemas to this matched source-only profile.
Do not remove secure reads/hash checks, trust mtime, silently truncate source, or omit code merely because a hash/session ID is known.
Do not silently unregister user MCP servers. The real launcher preserves user configuration; reproducing the benchmark requires an explicitly isolated per-invocation native profile.

narrow_refinement_evaluation.proposed_change: Request-local compiled-ignore-spec reuse only; freshly read policy bytes/source versions and normal rendered prompt bytes remain identical.
narrow_refinement_evaluation.first_checks: Verify exact before/after prompt/source-receipt equivalence, actual secure source/policy reader calls, ignored/changed/deleted/symlink/large-policy/race fallbacks, and one compile per unchanged policy within a single preparation. No persistent or body-content cache.
narrow_refinement_evaluation.local_performance: Alternate baseline/refined complete known-path preparations in isolated workers over explicit small/large/deep-ignore fixtures; include individual CPU/wall distributions, parser/compile counts and cold/warm setup separately. Report regressions and exact content equality. No model requests are needed.
narrow_refinement_evaluation.claim_boundary: Identical native prompt bytes/settings imply a paid model A/B cannot attribute token/cost variation to compiled-ignore caching. Only measured local preparation work can improve in this iteration; model savings and native speedups remain unproven.
narrow_refinement_evaluation.future_model_evaluation: Only a future source representation/workflow change that actually changes model-visible input warrants a fresh independently graded known-path A/B/C comparison; keep supplied-context controls separate and include cost per strict success, full time and cache-write uncertainty.

security_review.kind: Independent security and compatibility review of request-local compiled-policy reuse

observed_checks.limitation: Forced-miss current-code control emulates uncached compilation semantics; this is not a historical whole-application performance benchmark.
Forced-miss current-code control emulates uncached compilation semantics; this is not a historical whole-application performance benchmark.

observed_checks.memory_scope: Bounds retained policy text and entry count; compiled pattern objects and interpreter overhead are additional and unmeasured.

static_review.cache_identity: Exact freshly secured source string plus SHA-256 digest; empty specifications use an is-None miss test.
static_review.freshness: Every source and policy secure read, hash, absence/symlink check, per-pass byte budget, policy match and final fresh approval/settings/index-membership query remains in place.
static_review.scope: A new cache is created after initial project selection inside each prepare_prompt call. No cache or compiled object is returned in public results; default _eligible callers receive no shared cache.
static_review.limits: At most 64 entries and 64000 UTF-8 bytes of retained source content; overflow is compiled without retention rather than skipped.
static_review.base_paths: Compiled patterns are content-derived; ancestor base paths remain attached outside the shared specification in the existing rules traversal.
static_review.compatibility: The patch changes no public preparation signature, source envelope, source fidelity fields, legacy/compact layout, fallback rules, model settings, memory or MCP integration.

remaining_limits: These synthetic checks are not a full application, installed-artifact or model benchmark.
No runtime RSS or compiled-object heap bound was measured; 64000 bytes describes retained source text only.
Performance benefit depends on actual ignore-policy compilation overhead and must be measured separately without concurrent tests.

build_static.frontend_dependencies: Reused valid pinned dependencies; no manifest/lock changes

dependency_review.reviewed: Installed pinned GitIgnoreSpec.from_lines and check_file; compilation derives from lines and base directories remain external

engineering_validation.count_rule: One full Python suite count; overlapping 107-case preload and 19-case runner/other reruns are retained separately, never added. Frontend/browser and installed smoke have separate denominators.

limits: Synthetic source-only development fixtures and minimal SQLite approval tables; no real repository indexing, AST/Tree-sitter, held-out coding tasks or native agents ran in this local profile.
First-call API timing includes first lazy imports; warm uses one mean per worker. Diagnostic instrumentation, fallbacks, setup and subprocess lifetime are separate from primary API timings.
No fixture-weighted overall performance headline is computed. Fixture-specific variation, failures, missing pairs and no-effect controls remain visible.
Whole-worker Linux SELF peak RSS includes interpreter/imports/setup/preparation and is not incremental API memory. Maximum waited-child RSS is separate, not simultaneous total; never add peaks.
Own CPU excludes children; waited child CPU is a separate observed counter. OS caches and shared-host load remain uncontrolled.
Stable normal prompt bytes, source hashes and current source/policy read-call counts match. These are API read-call observations, not filesystem or storage I/O counts.
Identical native input/settings make a paid old/new model test non-attributable for this compiled-ignore cache. Local effects do not establish new token, cache-hit, billing or native-task savings.

Historical 9.055% lower estimated cost is a partial post-hoc matched warm cohort; 10.19% belongs to focused confirmation tasks while its all-task difference is about 2.47%. Those corpora are not pooled or attributed to this refinement.

coordinator_interpretation.compilation_work: Confirmed 6 to 3 compilations per typical call, 2 to 1 per dense call; read-call attempts, bytes and outcomes unchanged across 36 calls in six separate diagnostic workers. Performance workers were uninstrumented.
coordinator_interpretation.per_fixture_interpretation: All first/warm mean wall/own-CPU bootstrap intervals include zero. Dense paired warm medians improved within this fixture, while its mean worsened; ordinary cases do not show a reliable timing improvement.
coordinator_interpretation.outlier_causes: Unknown. Large calls also consumed own-process CPU; no per-call GC, syscall or scheduler trace was collected. Do not attribute them specifically to scheduling, garbage collection or the new cache.
coordinator_interpretation.memory_tradeoff: Median whole-worker SELF peak was 15.25 MiB in both arms for noignore/typical; dense was 15.875 MiB baseline versus 16.0 MiB candidate. This is a whole-worker peak and not an incremental cache allocation estimate.
coordinator_interpretation.product_scope: Keep the known-path complete-source architecture and zero extra selector calls. The compiled-rule change reduces derivation work and preserves context/safety; it is not advertised as a proven general latency or model-cost improvement.
coordinator_interpretation.next_diagnostic: Use a separate preregistered replication on realistic ignore layouts with enough independent workers to characterize tails; instrument GC/OS phases in separate diagnostic runs. Preserve this cohort and every outlier; do not rerun it to select a favorable result.
coordinator_interpretation.interval_scope: Unadjusted paired-worker bootstrap intervals across multiple fixture/phase/metric comparisons; favorable dense medians are exploratory component results.

independent_profile_audit.scope: Read-only independent reconstruction from preserved local worker receipts; no benchmark/preparer/fixture execution or model calls.
